subject: Quarter kickoff: goal framing, governance checklist, and QBR dry run
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Rebecca Chen <rebecca.chen@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter kickoff: goal framing, governance checklist, and QBR dry run

Team — attaching the first pass at the Q3 OKR slate and a short governance checklist I pulled together for Exec review. High level ask: please review and provide explicit approval or redlines by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize the packet for the QBR dry run next Tuesday.

Quick notes: 
- Goal framing: I kept three company-level objectives and mapped expected owner-level outcomes. See tab "Company-OKRs" in the spreadsheet.
- Governance: the attached checklist calls out what needs legal/finance signoff vs. what Exec needs to acknowledge.
- QBR dry run: proposed 40-minute run through + 20-minute Q&A. Draft agenda attached (qbr-dryrun-agenda.pdf).

Immediate asks: 
1) Kim — can you confirm the metrics and SLO wording under Objective 2 (cost / latency optimization)?
2) Lauren — can you shepherd the stakeholder list and confirm who will present customer highlights?
3) Grace — quick read on the governance checklist and call out any blockers for packaging to the board.

I put a Drive folder here with working slides and the H1 -> Q3 lineage: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBR-prep

Attachments: Q3_OKR_draft_v2.xlsx; qbr-dryrun-agenda.pdf; governance-checklist.csv

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff: goal framing, governance checklist, and QBR dry run

On Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 9:12 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — attaching the first pass at the Q3 OKR slate and a short governance checklist I pulled together for Exec review.
> 
> Quick notes: ...

Thanks, Mateo — good work. I did a pass and left comments inline in Q3_OKR_draft_v2.xlsx (column-level notes) and attached a small redline CSV for the governance checklist. Main things I flagged: 
- Objective 2 (cost/latency): suggested we change metric from "reduce p50 cost/token by 10%" to "reduce unit inference cost by 8% while maintaining p95 latency" — avoids gaming p50 only.
- Under Objective 1 owner mapping: move "Model runtime telemetry" to infra (Marcus can be a presenter).
- For the QBR slides: request that customer recovery examples do not include raw customer IDs; use hashed IDs instead for the slide deck.

I can follow up with Marcus and Legal if we need faster turnaround on telemetry ownership and data masking.

Attachments: governance-checklist-redline.csv

— Kim
Kimberly Park
VP, Product 
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff: goal framing, governance checklist, and QBR dry run

Thanks — skimmed and added a short presenter roster in the Drive notes. A couple of operational items: 
- Can we move the dry run to Tuesday 05/04 at 10:00 PT? Several stakeholders (sales leadership) are out Mon/Tue next week. If the majority prefer Tue AM, I will lock the room and send calendar invites.
- Customer highlight: Rebecca (Acme Analytics) has agreed to a 6-minute case study — I copied her earlier to confirm availability and to pre-screen the materials they are comfortable sharing.

If everyone signs off on the small changes Kim proposed, I'm comfortable moving to Exec review.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, GTM Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff: goal framing, governance checklist, and QBR dry run

Folks — thanks for the quick reads. Actions taken this morning: 
- Incorporated Kim's wording change on Objective 2 and uploaded Q3_OKR_draft_v2.xlsx -> Q3_OKR_draft_v3.xlsx in Drive.
- Applied the governance redlines; uploaded governance-checklist.csv (v2) and attached the redline CSV.
- Locked the dry run for Tue 05/04 10:00 PT and sent calendar invites to the group.

Rebecca — appreciate you volunteering the case study. Could you confirm the slide deck you'll share by EOD Monday so Lauren can slot it into the run order? Also flag any content that needs to be redacted.

Link to final working folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBR-prep
Attachments: Q3_OKR_draft_v3.xlsx; governance-checklist-v2.csv

If there are no further objections by Monday 17:00 PT we'll mark this as Exec-ready and I will circulate to the exec packet owners for signoff.

— Mateo
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff: goal framing, governance checklist, and QBR dry run

All looks good from my side — appreciate the quick turn. Two small asks before Exec packet: 
1) Add a short risk paragraph under Objective 3 noting dependency on Dedicated capacity expansion (ETA mid Q3).
2) Legal should confirm the data-handling paragraph in the customer slide appendix (Kim — can you confirm you looped Legal?).

Assuming those two items get addressed, you have my signoff to push to Exec review.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
